subject.title: fix(exec-approval): distinguish non-persistable command from ask=always policy in approval prompt

question: Should maintainers continue repairing this focused PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97069, or switch to a sibling PR with broader renderer coverage and proof?
rationale: Multiple open PRs target the same approval-copy bug, and this branch still has a native Telegram coverage gap plus a contributor proof gate.

options.title: Repair this PR before merge
options.body: Keep this branch open, carry the unavailable reason into native Telegram prompts, and require real prompt proof before considering it the landing path.

options.title: Promote a sibling canonical fix
options.body: If maintainers prefer a sibling PR with broader maintained coverage and proof, preserve this PR's useful context there and close this branch only after the canonical path is selected or merged.

recommendation.title: Repair this PR before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this branch open, carry the unavailable reason into native Telegram prompts, and require real prompt proof before considering it the landing path.
